questions.stem: A radioactive sample has an activity of 800 Bq. After two half-lives, what will the activity be?
questions.explanation: After one half-life, the activity halves: 800 / 2 = 400 Bq. After a second half-life, it halves again: 400 / 2 = 200 Bq. Each half-life reduces the activity by half, regardless of the starting value.
